title: Network device logs
description: Syslog of the VyOS leaves, fw-wan, MikroTik spines and CRS317s, FS switches and C9800 WLCs: BGP/BFD, interface, STP, login and config events, AP and client events, per-device timelines.

list.name: search
list.label: Search (regex)
list.description: Case-insensitive RE2 regex on the line; empty matches everything.

panels.title: BGP / BFD
panels.description: Log lines: RouterOS session state lines ('<session> {l_addr: .., r_addr: ..} Established/Idle') and 'BFD session was not established'. FRR on VyOS logs %ADJCHANGE and BFD state changes at informational, but VyOS sets 'log syslog notifications', so its sessions come from frr_exporter (Prometheus) instead. FRR: BGP and BFD session flaps in range (state changes or uptime restarts, see the Routing row).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"$device"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `\{l_addr: [^}]*\} [A-Za-z]+|(?i:state-change|bfd session|\bbgp\b.*\b(established|idle|notification|hold timer)\b)` [$__range])) or vector(0)

(sum(max by (host, vrf, peer, peer_hostname, afi, safi) (changes(frr_bgp_peer_state{host=~"(?i)$device"}[$__range] ) or label_replace(resets(frr_bgp_peer_uptime_seconds{host=~"(?i)$device"}[$__range] ), "via_", "uptime", "", ""))) or vector(0)) + (sum(max by (host, local, peer) (changes(frr_bfd_peer_state{host=~"(?i)$device"}[$__range] ) or label_replace(resets(frr_bfd_peer_uptime{host=~"(?i)$device"}[$__range] ), "via_", "uptime", "", ""))) or vector(0))

panels.title: Interface up/down
panels.description: Kernel 'Link is Up/Down' (VyOS), RouterOS 'link up/down', Cisco/FS %LINK/%LINEPROTO UPDOWN (not systemd's 'ifupdown' units).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"$device"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i:\blink is (up|down)\b|\blink (up|down)\b|\bupdown\b|changed state to (up|down|administratively down)|carrier (lost|acquired))` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: STP
panels.description: Spanning tree: topology changes, port role/state changes (also Linux bridge port states on VyOS).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"$device"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i:spantree|\bstp\b|mstp|rstp|topology change|topo(logy)?[ _-]?change|entered (blocking|forwarding|disabled|listening|learning) state)` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Auth failures
panels.description: Failed SSH/console logins: sshd, RouterOS 'login failure', FS 'auth fail', IOS-XE %SEC_LOGIN-4-LOGIN_FAILED.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"$device"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i:failed password|invalid user|authentication failure|login failure|auth fail|login_failed|authentication failed|failed publickey|maximum authentication attempts|bad password)` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Logins
panels.description: Successful logins: sshd 'Accepted ...', RouterOS/FS 'logged in', IOS-XE %SEC_LOGIN-5-LOGIN_SUCCESS. The automation on a0-nix (10.20.250.255) logs in often.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"$device"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i:accepted (publickey|password|keyboard-interactive)|logged in|login_success)` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Config changes
panels.description: VyOS commits, RouterOS '... changed by user', FS/IOS-XE 'Configured from' and saves.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"$device"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i:successful change to active configuration|config_i\b|%sys-\d-config|configured from|startup-config is wrote|\b(added|changed|removed|moved) by [a-z-]+:)` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: AP join/leave
panels.description: C9800: access points joining or leaving the controller (%CAPWAPAC_SMGR_TRACE_MESSAGE-5-AP_JOIN_DISJOIN), AP reboots and AIR state.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"$device"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i:ap_join|disjoin|ap event|ap_air_state|\bap\b.*\b(joined|disassociated|reboot)\b|capwap.*\b(join|down)\b)` | host=~"c9800-wlc-[0-9]+" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Client failures
panels.description: C9800: wireless clients excluded, failing 802.1X/MAB/web auth or being rejected (WLC lines only).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="syslog", host=~"$device"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `(?i:client_exclusion|exclusionlist|dot1x.*fail|mab.*fail|webauth.*fail|client.*(fail|reject|exclu|deauth|timeout))` | host=~"c9800-wlc-[0-9]+" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: BGP session changes
panels.description: FRR on the VyOS leaves and fw-wan (frr_exporter, Prometheus; the device picker applies). VyOS doesn't send FRR's %ADJCHANGE to syslog (it sets 'log syslog notifications'). Sessions that changed state at a scrape, restarted (uptime went back: also flaps shorter than the scrape interval, like a bgpd restart) or aren't established now. State changes count both directions (down and up again = 2).

targets.expr: max by (host, vrf, peer, peer_hostname, afi, safi) (changes(frr_bgp_peer_state{host=~"(?i)$device"}[$__range])) and on (host, vrf, peer, peer_hostname, afi, safi) ((max by (host, vrf, peer, peer_hostname, afi, safi) (changes(frr_bgp_peer_state{host=~"(?i)$device"}[$__range] ) or label_replace(resets(frr_bgp_peer_uptime_seconds{host=~"(?i)$device"}[$__range] ), "via_", "uptime", "", ""))) > 0 or max by (host, vrf, peer, peer_hostname, afi, safi) (frr_bgp_peer_state{host=~"(?i)$device"} ) != 1)

max by (host, vrf, peer, peer_hostname, afi, safi) (resets(frr_bgp_peer_uptime_seconds{host=~"(?i)$device"}[$__range])) and on (host, vrf, peer, peer_hostname, afi, safi) ((max by (host, vrf, peer, peer_hostname, afi, safi) (changes(frr_bgp_peer_state{host=~"(?i)$device"}[$__range] ) or label_replace(resets(frr_bgp_peer_uptime_seconds{host=~"(?i)$device"}[$__range] ), "via_", "uptime", "", ""))) > 0 or max by (host, vrf, peer, peer_hostname, afi, safi) (frr_bgp_peer_state{host=~"(?i)$device"} ) != 1)

max by (host, vrf, peer, peer_hostname, afi, safi) (frr_bgp_peer_uptime_seconds{host=~"(?i)$device"}) and on (host, vrf, peer, peer_hostname, afi, safi) ((max by (host, vrf, peer, peer_hostname, afi, safi) (changes(frr_bgp_peer_state{host=~"(?i)$device"}[$__range] ) or label_replace(resets(frr_bgp_peer_uptime_seconds{host=~"(?i)$device"}[$__range] ), "via_", "uptime", "", ""))) > 0 or max by (host, vrf, peer, peer_hostname, afi, safi) (frr_bgp_peer_state{host=~"(?i)$device"} ) != 1)

defaults.noValue: No BGP session changed in range

panels.title: BGP session state
panels.description: FRR on the VyOS leaves and fw-wan (frr_exporter, Prometheus; the device picker applies). VyOS doesn't send FRR's %ADJCHANGE to syslog (it sets 'log syslog notifications'). The sessions of the table on the left over time, at scrape resolution: a restart shorter than the scrape interval doesn't show here. Gaps: the exporter wasn't scraped or bgpd was restarting.

targets.expr: max by (host, vrf, peer, peer_hostname, afi, safi) (frr_bgp_peer_state{host=~"(?i)$device"}) and on (host, vrf, peer, peer_hostname, afi, safi) ((max by (host, vrf, peer, peer_hostname, afi, safi) (changes(frr_bgp_peer_state{host=~"(?i)$device"}[$__range] @ end()) or label_replace(resets(frr_bgp_peer_uptime_seconds{host=~"(?i)$device"}[$__range] @ end()), "via_", "uptime", "", ""))) > 0 or max by (host, vrf, peer, peer_hostname, afi, safi) (frr_bgp_peer_state{host=~"(?i)$device"} @ end()) != 1)

defaults.noValue: No BGP session changed in range

max by (host, local, peer) (frr_bfd_peer_uptime{host=~"(?i)$device"}) and on (host, local, peer) ((max by (host, local, peer) (changes(frr_bfd_peer_state{host=~"(?i)$device"}[$__range] ) or label_replace(resets(frr_bfd_peer_uptime{host=~"(?i)$device"}[$__range] ), "via_", "uptime", "", ""))) > 0 or max by (host, local, peer) (frr_bfd_peer_state{host=~"(?i)$device"} ) != 1)

defaults.noValue: No BFD session changed in range

panels.title: RouterOS BGP session changes
panels.description: RouterOS session state lines (spines, CRS317: session name, remote address, state).

targets.expr: {source="syslog", host=~"$device"} |~ `(?i)$search` |~ `\{l_addr: ` | regexp `(?P<peer_name>\S+) \{l_addr: [^,]+, r_addr: (?P<peer>[^}]+)\} (?P<state>[A-Za-z]+(?: [a-z]+)*)`

panels.title: Interface events per device
